notes.title: 1.76.0 update is now up
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/6cb3e3bfb0a293ab3eea3c9e716701705d85deab.png"][/img]A new Item slot has been added: Accessories[/p][p]The new slot unlocks at e425, with all items being craftable, sports 10 items, all of which belong to existing item sets - allowing you to mix and match your gear more, while maintaining a powerful full set bonus! To accomodate this a bit more, the void set has been updated with a new bonus and the empowering shoulderguards are now a 4% incantation enchant gearpiece. Versatility has been moved to e725, instead, to stop confusing players as to whether it's worth investing or not early on (spoiler: it's not).[/p][p]Also included: Ranger and Shapeshifter-themed Orbs and a Ranger-themed Spellhound/Arcanaworg.[/p][p]And a lot of various significant and minor bug fixes[/p][p]Come visit us![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.74.0 update is now up
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/f13730b52bf5f07794f41f3c190d5429ecfedbc8.png"][/img][/p][p]Pantheon mechanics have been reworked![/p][p][/p][p]New Feature: Temple. You now possess a number of Acolytes, which you can assign to specific Gods to pray to them, while free Acolytes will instead grant progress towards gaining Boons (Offerings, Scriptures, Tenets). Boons gain this speed nonlinearly, and rarer Boons require more Acolytes available at once. You can invest these Boons into specific Gods to various effects: Offering double XP gained for an hour, Scriptures boost XP gained and Tenets increase either the first or the second Ability Power, with both Scriptures and Tenets lasting until Realming. Excess Offerings can also be used for Rites (instantly gaining 30 minutes of Gods XP for each God with an Acolyte, costing 1 Offering per active God).[/p][p]Gods level scaling and requirements were changed. The Major Gods' total levels are now roughly 10 lower while retaining roughly the same total bonus, Minor Gods are roughly twice lower with the same bonus. Gods now have an additional mechanic of Goals, gaining a multiplier on top of their bonus on specific levels (5th, 10th and every 10th afterwards).[/p][p]Acolytes are gained through gaining Pantheon-related Paragons, reaching specific maximum levels among all Gods (10, 25 and every 25th afterwards) and Renown.[/p][p]Attention: Paramnesics were reset to allow for investing into "Misleading Insight".[/p][p][/p][p]Related to Pantheon rework:[/p][p]- "Misleading Insight". New Paramnesic that increases Splinter income.[/p][p]- "Overlapping Cycle" Imprint changed. Now increases God XP gained until the corresponding God reaches their all-time max level again.[/p][p]- "Contraligia" Minor God. Bonus changed. Splinter income moved to the new Paramnesic.[/p][p]- "Mundigenia" Minor God. Bonus changed. Total bonus for Enchanting Dust spread between base rates, Legacy bonuses and Trial Milestones (see "Balance").[/p][p]- Enchanting dust gain increases from Legacy doubled.[/p][p]- Enchanting dust gain increases from Trial milestones reshuffled and significantly increased overall.[/p][p]- Base Enchanting dust income increased by 56%.[/p][p]- Minor Gods now always drain XP at base XP gain rate and all XP bonuses affecting Minor Gods increase drain (previously "Minor Gods xp gain" bonus did not increase drain).[/p][p]- Base God XP rate is now twice as low, which is compensated by being able to invest offerings (doubled XP gain) while also gaining new ones with the higher amount of Acolytes than Gods selected previously.[/p][p]- Renown reward for simultaneous Gods replaced with Acolytes amount, with values increased.[/p][p][/p][p]Among other changes:[/p][p]- "Head Of The All-Eater" weapon. Reworked. Now grants a passive bonus that depends on Exile's total stats. Bonus formula reduced (x2 less), will still result in a larger bonus on average given the significantly bigger amount of stats accumulated compared to the previous charging period.[/p][p]- Added Realm History, displaying information about last 20 Realms.[/p][p]- Changed the format of displaying item bonuses. Now the bonus from Masterworks/Exhibits/Breakthroughs/Proficiency is shown after the total bonus in form of "(+X%)".[/p][p]A lot of various significant and minor bug fixes[/p][p]Come visit us![/p]

notes.title: The 1.73 update is now up
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/7bf8d97368078aecfdb3e0777a57fc09145f8931.png[/img]

New Mythic mechanic: Masterworking. A new way to upgrade Mythic items that increases all Inherent bonuses, rolled bonuses and Imbuements.

Also includes:
- 4 new Mythics (2 for both Legs and Back slots).
- Mythic items amount cap increased to 25 (was 20).
- 3 Heritages and 1 Paramnesic were added last patch.

Some minor rebalance and buffs, several bug and stability fixes included.

Check it out!

notes.title: The 1.71 update is now up
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/c2bc8b7a30a00ac01362bb1659a05a042b4a5345.png[/img]

New Mythic mechanic: Imbuement. Allows you to expand the functionality of your Mythic items by adding up to 2 new powers (Imbuements) to them. First, you select a specific pool of Imbuements to choose from, then the resulting power is selected from that pool at random.

Also includes:
- 4 new Mythics and 2 new slots (wrist and belt), 2 items each.
- Mythic items amount cap increased to 20 (was 15).
- Item sets received new, powerful bonuses when completed, and had some of the other bonuses rehashed.

Several bug and stability fixes included.

Check it out!

notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello fellow Wizards!

The previous Roadmap's run is over, and we're announcing the new 2025/26 Roadmap!

Last year, one of the major features for us was implementing a translations module. We've started as early as the beginning of 2024, but it was a humongous task. Now, the technical part is done, and it's already available live. Another big feature we've done outside of the original Roadmap was the Mythic Items, and we intend to keep expanding upon both their amount and their functionality later on this year. We've also populated the Realm map with a great amount of various Quasi-Realms, including 4 new Class ones.

This year we're planning on:
- Further improving Mythic items. New bases for slots that did not have any before, new customization/improvement options for them.
- A rework of Pantheon, making it more flexible and complex. This rework will also lay a good foundation for further improving the Pantheon by introducing Pantheon Memetics.
- We're looking into restructuring earlier Paragons. Currently, there's a great amount of power available to the player early on, but new players instead are often overwhelmed by the amount of mechanics they're introduced to all at once in a short period of time. We believe somehow spacing them out will allow players to get more familiar with things they already have before moving on to the new thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/b9ecb6a81874c71d86368143832719c6e6ccd60b.png[/img]

Along with other updates, we'll be including:
- More Quasi-Realms, T2 Classes Quasis
- More Enhancement Spells
- More Paramnesics, Heritages, Imprints
- New Skins

As before, it's a rough estimate and it's possible we'll move or include some things if necessary.

Thank you and stay tuned!

notes.title: Shards Of Heaven
notes.content:
1.70 update, "Shards Of Heaven", is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/83cf9d4db1bf8ad9cca28a6e8c0170c05a8b83c7.png[/img]

- New feature: Mythic Items
You can now craft a set of items of a new quality of items: Mythics. Only one Mythic item can be equipped at any time (but you can possess up to 15). This items have a base "inherent" bonus that depends on the item type and 3 random bonuses. The enchant type is freely changeable at any time, with the pool of available enchant types matching the enchant types that can be found on regular items in this slot. The random bonuses can be rerolled for Nullifiers.

Also, the Wizard's Hat Annual Tournament Event is now live!

Log in to receive a humble entry gift and participate in the Wizard's Hat Annual Tournament Event!
Complete the Tasks and collect bonus points to gain progress in a series of goals, each unlocking a new reward, with the final goal of gaining a new Mount!

In addition, there's a bonus to Trial Rune generation speed that'll last until March 15th.

Among other changes, some directly tied to the new Mythic Items mechanic:

- "Rare goodies" experiment removed.
- 2 new Experiments: "Nullifiers" (chance to get a random amount of Nullifiers) and "Rune progress" (give double, compared to other experiments, Rune progress per Dust spent). Effect of Crafting and Experiment efficiency works on both.
- Option "Buy all Mana Sources" now always available. Paragon 10 replaced by Paragon 29 (Increases attribute cap by 25).
- Disenchantment core removed from the game. Disenchanting now costs Nullifiers. All Disenchantment Cores you had on hand were converted into Nullifiers at 10:6 rate. Amount of Nullifiers gained from Market wares is now double or higher.
- Gods experience gain increased by 50%.
- Expedition Keys now can be also traded by 1000s (hotkey Alt).
- By popular demand, increased the maximum zoom for the Realms map.

Come visit us!

notes.title: The 1.69 update is now up
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/efc243813fdc16bda5c5226ec88446a5ef1bb081.png[/img]

We've finally integrated translations into the game - Russian language is available, while German and French are available via machine translation for now. We also intend to add more languages with community's support. Keep in mind there's a select few sections of the game still untranslated - soon to be finished.

Another highlight of the patch is the removal of the Forge. Forge is no more! All the items are always available.

Some quasi rebalances, bug fixes and a lot of typos and ambiguous phrasing fixed.


It is also Christmas Season in Idle Wizard!

We at TwoWizards wish you a Merry Christmas!

Starting from December 16th and up to January 16th, log in to receive numerous gifts!

Check out some new visuals, try out Christmas skins for additional merriness!

Come join us for the celebration!

notes.title: It's Idle Wizards' 8th Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/d28ab75830ae8e20a98dbdf0f8f846f1d16cffc5.png[/img]

For a month, starting today, everyone logging in will receive some bonus stuff and buffs.
The update is mostly a technical one and includes the following things:
- Character XP rewards no longer are an accumulated flat XP, but instead add to a multiplicative component, stacking exponentially (1.002 from Bat and 1.005 from Corruption, not affected by drop quantity bonus). This is to remove the issue of having to equip xp-granting gear every time you collect a corruption.
- Added a Quest about Exiling and cleared up some requirements.
- A couple of fixes to enhanced spells, memetics and more.
A collection of event items is awarded upon entering the Anniversary event!

Come join us for celebration!

notes.title: 1.66 update is now up
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/8b19289e53d7e1fd4f4f5e7ba51c8b9fc33b197b.png[/img]

New Feature: Quests. An expanded tutorial/introduction comprised of a series of tasks with rewards, mostly aimed towards explaining the game's basic mechanics to new players.

Manual reset of Memories removed, Memories can now only be reset when Realming. Choose wisely!
"Unseen Efficiency" and "Unending Resource" Heritages have been removed from the game. You now permanently possess a bonus to Enchanting Dust and Catalyst Shards earned roughly equal to what you'd possess if you invested all of your Memories into either "Unseen Efficiency" or "Unending Resource".

New Enhancement Spells available: "Spirit Of Valor" and "Conjure Void Elemental", available from completing the "Redemption" and "The Great Crusade" Quasi-Realms, respectively.
New Imprint: Forged Affinity. Allows you to retain some of your Attribute Points after Realming.

And a couple of bugfixes and balance tweaks.

Check it out!

notes.title: Halloween Event is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/12267e245f07052b7ed2fda5c09978103ab8047c.png[/img]

Log in to receive a humble entry gift and try out some of the new spooky skins!
Trade Pumpkin Seeds with our resident Pumpkin for some random Skin unlocks or minor random gifts. Seeds can be earned by collecting them from the game's screen, where they spawn periodically.

The pumpkin is, as always, full of cheeky retorts!
In addition, there's a bonus to Bats, Crafting and Enchanting Dust that'll last until November 10th.

There's also quite a few gameplay changes, including:
- 8 Legacy levels and 72 new upgrades.
- Almost every Paramnesic bonus increased to around ~x3 profits up from ~x2. Some were balanced towards being useful all the way across, so the first point is weaker, but the total for 5/10 invested is higher that before.

- A new Market item: The Dust Gatherer! 
Automatically collects Crafting Dust from Jars, with an extra upgrade generating additional 1 dust per minute (1440 per day), unaffected by Dust bonuses. Also Increases Crafting Dust cap. 
- Correspondingly, we've increased the amount of Crafting Dust in each pack by 20% on average. If you already posses a Master, Grandmaster or Crafting pack you will receive the difference immediately upon loading.

And some bugfixes along the way.

Come visit us!

notes.title: 1.64 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/66ff314773bd4c26ece015a062940ed6e65fd49a.png[/img]

New feature: Trophy upgrade - Exhibits
Exhibits function not unlike Breakthroughs, allowing Trophies to increase the power of their basic bonuses. Exhibits are earnable through Expeditions and drop the same way Trophies drop initially, after the corresponding Trophy has reached Legendary quality.

A couple of new enhancement Spells were introduced: Jas'Aham's Missile Storm Spell, Nightfall and Primal Power.
Exhibits also come with a new Imprint and a Paramnesic: Pseudo-Fossils, a new Imprint that allows for carryover of Exhibits, and Exaggerated Spoils, a new Paramnesic that increases Expedition rewards.

Some of the previous Enhancements have also received buffs, and Fire Ball has been reworked.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.63 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/40b5fd8cf3b1926ee58b4f0911d2389297c01507.png[/img]

New Quasi-Realm featuring Abolisher with a unique Doppelganger's attributes feature and a switchable Pet, and an Abolisher portrait to go along with it.

Enhanced "Rules of Nature" and "Fireball" Spells, obtainable from the "Rainforest" and "Feral Abyss" Quasi-Realms, respectively.

Most Classes and Pets no longer require time, offline time or idle time spent to unlock them or had it made simpler (hooray!).

And a couple of bugfixes and balance tweaks.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.61 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/4936d6c641df6a8c1aea06a5fb8e5763dda72d07.png[/img]

A new Quasi Realm with a unique Class - the Nosferatu, along with its unique visuals, spells and effects. It utilizes both Liquid Shadow and Blood - a new unique resource of the class.

Nosferatu comes along with a new background, cursor, orb and 2 portraits available for customization.
A couple of offline features have also been improved, including offline Heart of the Grave functionality.
Check it out!

notes.title: Tools Of Usurpation
notes.content:
1.60 update, "Tools Of Usurpation", is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/ac04882211447394307b8c75eb0e2c3192b50c19.png[/img]

New feature: Proficiency. 
A new mechanic, allowing you to upgrade your existing items further. A new currency, called Proficiency Shards, can be earned through a new Experiment. Investing in an item increases its basic bonuses by a certain percent, depending on the stat. This power is lost upon Realming.

Some other, more minor stuff:

- 3 new Character skins.
- 3 new Pet skins.
- 4 new Orb skins.
- Nullifiers were added to the Trials' normal reward lists, along with increasing the amount of Nullifier and Disenchantment Cores gained from Rare goodies experiments.

Including some extra qol, bugfixes and optimizations.

Come check it out!

notes.title: Solstice Event is live!
notes.content:
A Solstice is occuring the Realm! Common folk pay tributes to the Gods and hope for rich crops and good luck in return. Nothing's stopping you for participating as well, though! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/40f46e81c6899d090244b03a547759c733f847b5.png[/img]

Collect Embers and invest them into any of the 4 Jars that are accessible through the event Jar on the main game screen to gain temporary bonuses to various resources. The Crystallized Echo mount is also once again available for purchase!

Starting from June 16th and up to July 16th an Event will be active that includes collection of embers and paying tributes in exchange for bonuses, with a small gift and a buff to Runes gained to top it off!

Meanwhile, we have updated the client to version 1.58.0:
 - even more Offline functionality, making it pretty close to full online even for classes that have special mechanics
 - Time Warps have been vastly improved, allowing to accrue Spells, Expeditions, Trials and more
 - brand new set of visuals for the Spellbook, which stayed unchanged since the earliest days of Idle Wizard (which is... years)
 - fancy new Orbs!
 
Check it out and come join us for the celebration!

notes.title: 1.57 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/8e184bf0444ce84a9b7e86a085a14e84e4042a60.png[/img]

Offline progress has seen a couple of significant improvements - autoclicks now count offline, based on your average autoclicks (same as Spellcasts). Auto Idle expedition now works offline up to 24h, including key-locked ones.

Renown bonuses have been boosted, and Spell Sets were made baseline (now you always possess 10 sets, same as items) and thus removed from Renown. Multiple bonuses were either moved earlier or introduced to them.

A batch of of new Character and Pet skins!

Balance tweaks - Branch of the Great Cycle is now way more powerful, do mind that the display was changed to represent the difference with a normal summoning spell, so the number might look lower than it was (in reality, it's way higher now).

Trophies now drop more readily and in higher amounts now, both normal and key-locked ones.

We've found and fixed a notorious case where Spell sets could disappear when saving other sets, which many players reported.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.56 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/6a759e7e5b9a3b2aa24b7f0e578d405fb0c53ca5.png[/img]

A new Quasi Realm with a unique Class - the long-requested Cryomancer, along with its unique visuals, spells and effects. Even your game's screen shall freeze! We're also planning to release more quasis with new classes from time to time - stay tuned :) We're still intent on making an Ironsoul and Abolisher quasis to cover everyone, of course.

A lot of Summoning spells that previously served little purpose, like Conjure Elemental, Automaton or demonic summons, have been granted accumulated tags and new effects that scale off casts and/or summon efficiency, making them rather worth to have.

We have also introduced a couple of new items that help with Summoning duration to better stack these updated summons, as well as buffed some set bonuses and introduced an incantation efficiency enchant in the finger slot (finally!).

Instead of Elementals, Archon gets a completely new spell that buffs some of the pet's stats and spell charges.

It's also worth mentioning that we have made some balance changes, due to accumulating some data on how classes perform comparatively to each other, as well due to recent changes granting some classes more power where it wasn't intended.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.53 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/d996efed43ed02b2a7e1701dca999714e8a27c5c.png[/img]

A small content and tech patch, including a new Quasi-Realm featuring a rather different Umbramancer, a couple of new cosmetics and some balance fixes.

Hard reset button also moved out of the harm's way!

Check it out!

notes.title: Overture To The Collapse
notes.content:
1.50 update, "Overture To The Collapse", is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/ac1840e2e870a43656be6ccd56249fd66d61a498.png[/img]

New feature: Realmcraft. 
You can now select a special type of Realm upon Changing Realm - Quasi-Realms. These special Realms each have their own rules, restrictions and conditions to unlock. Instead of awarding Memories, they award Delusions - a new type of currency that you can spend on Paramnesics upgrades - a new type of upgrades not unlike Memory upgrades (now called Heritages). We will also be adding new types with new rules over time.

Some other, more minor stuff:

- Demiurge. New Ascension ability: Increases Attributes' per-point bonus' power.
- 3 new Legacy levels.
- 3 new achievements.
- All autoclicks are now calculated in bulk (critical profit and chance are averaged, shards and Pet experience (if applicable) are applied 4 times per second), the floating text now shows the total Mana gained, total clicks performed and display the average amount of crits through changing the text color from white to red (richer red corresponds to a higher percentage of crits within the total amount of clicks summarized).

We have also rehashed a part of UI to better fit the idea of different types of Realm - note the new main Scroll tab.

Including some extra qol, bugfixes and optimizations.

Come check it out!

notes.title: It's Christmas Season in Idle Wizard!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/ede4f285aee1ac72d55db7b60e3c15136a45b2de.png[/img]

We at TwoWizards wish you a Merry Christmas!
Starting from December 16th and up to January 16th, log in to receive numerous gifts!
Check out some new visuals, try out Christmas skins for additional merriness!

In the meantime, we've also had a couple of minor patches, including:
- A total of 17 new pet skins. Some of the old skins also inherited to higher tiers. Comes bundled with an updated Pet Skins panel.
- New UI option: Memory presets. A separate menu that allows you to create a preset set of Memory investments.
- New UI option: Max invest catalysts. Disables the input field and instead attempts to invest into a source until shards run out.
- A couple of fixes including Relentlessness and Spell Charges preservation upon reloading.

Come join us for the celebration!

notes.title: Idle Wizards' 7th Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/f774bf4390eb8d90cac2b6de132f0ea022929e2a.png[/img]

It's Idle Wizards' 7th Anniversary!

For a month, starting today, everyone logging in will receive some bonus stuff and buffs.

The update also includes some new things, such as:

- New Shaman-specific idle bar mechanic. Shaman has gained a new personal mechanic that augment the idle bar through the amount of autoclicks currently performed, which increase the Idle bonus they have.
- 2 new Mounts.
- 1 new Phylactery.

One of the new Mounts is awarded upon entering the Anniversary event!

Come join us for celebration!

notes.title: 1.48 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/a386e0d2f82bc9d52ff9019b6abb507723d5cd98.png[/img]

A new item slot: Phylactery.
An empowered gem not unlike a Soul Shard. They bestow bonuses that scale off the Character level and usually combine positive effects with a negative one.

We've also added the long-promised Calendar window - click the small calendar icon in the bottom right-ish corner you'd usually look up the weekly or event details on to check on our Event and Weekly schedule!

Regional prices are now a thing!

A renewed Steam page, along with the new, up-to-date, trailer is also here now.

2 new Triumphs to achieve!

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.47 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/c36cfca833ed56d667ff89eda4bf2310ebab8b96.png[/img]

Corruption Feature. It's new Collectable type - can reward Relics, Alteration Sands, Crafting Dust, Memetic Splinters, Ingots and Ink, Breakthroughs, Pet and Character experience (a new, separate bonus that adds flat experience amount based on your Character experience totals) . Trials and Experiments no longer yield Relics (so you're no longer obliged to wrap your head around dumping them en masse or not - feel free to!). Stacks up to 12 instances (~day, offline too!). Spawns once per 125 minutes.

Bats also yield Character experience the same way now.

Some bugfixes, like accounting for multi-enchanting for Trials, or finally fixing an esteemed 3 years old bug that made Innovation grant half the Research item craft progress on crits instead of doubling it (as intended).

And a new Triumph!

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.45 update is now up!
notes.content:
Tech and QoL patch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/eb1b6a6bbf4f9613ba6defd2c64ee3df6161ef18.png[/img]

New offline feature: Spellcasts! They now count during offline time (only actual time with the game closed counts, doesn't include Timewarps or Wormholes). This works through using your current spells' cast rate - which means this also includes casts gained through others means like Berzerker, Jas'Aham's Missile Storm, etc.

We've enabled custom cursors for the first time since Temporal Conflux update - years have passed since then! You can enable/disable them in the options.

Animated backgrounds have been visually intensified, since we've received feedback that animations were hard to notice.

A lot of bugfixes and small changes like Cataclysm's charges and being able to invest all Memories with an alt-click into uncapped Memory Upgrades.

And a new Triumph!


Check it out!

notes.title: 1.44 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/aea3eec960eb0ea427690f6bc07e80341f6dda15.png[/img]

A big visuals and GUI update! We've implemented animated elements for more than half of existing backgrounds and a new animated background. The Character selection screen was reworked to give you a much better overview. The orbs and background previews can now display their respective animations, orb preview reworked to use new visuals.

Automatic expeditions are now a cheap, separate purchase and can be also upgraded to improve the win chance. If you had Renown VI before - you will automatically get it. Renown VI is now also cheaper and more powerful, but doesn't grant auto expeditions anymore.

Alteration sand purchases are now x1.5 more efficient per Relic spent.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.43 update is now up!
notes.content:
A bunch of stuff all around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/76c57aa23d8fd0306055aa24d3581710b458c876.png[/img]

Innovation Trial rework: Breakthroughs. When you have all Research items at Legendary, Innovation trial will instead reward you with Breakthroughs that increase the bonus of a Research item for the rest of the Realm. The reward is distributed at random, but the chance for the specific Research to receive the Breakthrough is directly tied to the item's current enchant level - with enchant level 0 guaranteeing it does not receive them.

- 5 new Triumphs
- You can now set a personalized name for Item and Spell sets!

And a lot more various qol and fixes, from simultanous item+spell sets switching or finally making Tempest's 7th spell shown on spellsets and having a hotkey to reworking Scales of Appraisal and buffing Zenith!

Check it out!

notes.title: Fall From Grace
notes.content:
1.40 update, "Fall From Grace", is now up.

Godly powers and fundamental laws of the world are increasingly distorted and twisted, providing new opportunities and spelling disaster at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/8a7fb962cba9daa6378e49bcac6c6594cf03416c.png[/img]

New Feautre: Spell Memetics
Allows you to exchange Memetic Splinters for Memetic Ink. The Ink can be spent on Spells, increasing their Efficiency ang granting them additional perks depending on Spell type, while also making them cost more Spell Shards (or taking longer to charge, in case of Spells that charge on non-percent basis). It can also be used to increase your Shards Pool maximum size. Investing in either also provides you Spell Memetic Mastery progress, which also grants extra perks.

- 8 new Legacy levels.
- 19 new Achievements.
- Source Memetics don't reset on Realm Change anymore and cannot be reset with Nullifiers within the run. They can now be reset upon exile along with Spell Memetics, returning Ingots and Ink.
- "Doppelganger" and "Soulstealer" pets have had their Shards Pool capacity bonus increased to address the spellcasting issue on Abolisher and early Archon.
- "Netherloop", "Legacy", "Nether Chain" and "Nethershackles" items enchant bonuses changed to Void Mana per Entity (was Void Profits) to make way for Void Radiance to be competitive again.
- Some UI visuals reworked - a new Chronomancer CT bar and Skill bars included.

And a ton of other balancing and qol

Come visit us!

notes.title: 1.37 update is now up!
notes.content:
A bit technical patch in preparation for Spell Memetics update coming next. Included are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/1306043dc0f14e96cb818f9e1563a2a3550a6c57.png[/img]

A Spell Shards pool and Shards distribution rework
All Spell Shards gained are now accumulated into the reworked Shards Pool and then 10% of your total is distributed into your selected spells every 0.1 second. The Pool has an upgradeable cap of Shards it can accumulate that maxes out at e7 and higher for Abolisher and Archon through respective pets' perks.

Some balance and core changes (see full patchnotes ingame):
- Base mana source costs reduced.
- "Psychic Cacophony". New ability at level 700 - increase amount of Arcanasprings, equal to (level - 700).
- Forbidden Might. Now has a maximum level of 10, price increment reduced from 8e5 per level to 5e5 per level.
- Void Memetic. Trap bonuses for Void Profits and Void per Entity increased from x1.5 to x2 per Trap's level, from x1.24 to x1.5 for Liquid Shadows.
- "Soulstealer" pet. Evolution to "Psychic Cacophony" now available at 325.
- "Spellstaff Of Chamaon" spell. Now increase Evocation efficiency as an additional effect, with Incantation efficiency scaling of ^0.8.
- Trial of Valor. Spells' cooldown reduced in half.
- Temporal Stabilizer weapon. The gap between Common and Legendary quality drastically reduced, Legendary quality bonus unchanged.

And quite a bit of other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.35 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/377dd9eec163f02aee1570549d60f8a1279c1b71.png[/img]
New item slot: Mounts
A series of items with unique bonuses that mostly augment stacking phases in various aspects. Unlike regular items, only 2 of the Mounts can be crafted - other 4 can be acquired by completing various activities.

Balance:
- Auto-trial mode is now a baseline feature (was unlocked by Paragon 28).
- Leg item slot unlock moved up to to Paragon 25 (1e360) (was Paragon 26 at 1e380).
- Versatility attribute is now unlocked at Paragon 28 (1e425) (was Paragon 25 at 1e360).
- Oni and Ironsoul classes. Stances' power formula now works as if you had at least 1 cast performed (used to start from 0).
- Upgrades unlocked through a manual click requirement now require a certain amount of autoclicks instead.
- Geode and Ley Keeper pets. Effect duration reduced, bonus to all attributes increased, bonus to chosen attribute reduced, now boosts an attribute going in order from first to last, instead of being random.
- "Slavedriver" challenge. Rebalanced, reward changed.

- 32 new achievements
- Item slots in crafting menu now have enchanting level labels.

And quite a bit of other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.34 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/9e00299057c2a5039cf3ae5653dfafbe6fecb6df.png[/img]

The Defiance. New Ascension form, can be accessed by Archon, Oni and Shaman.
Shares Nullzone, Unclean Knowledge and Nightfall spells, and grants the Employ Celestial Countermeasures spell - a Permanent Incantation that boosts Evocation and Summoning efficiency.
Defiance's unique feature is switching between two sub-forms that have different Character Abilities - a Voidmana Per Entity as a buildup form, and a Transcendent form that has an individual ability dependent on your basic Character Class.

- Spellcast rate counters that show individual spell's rate - including fake sources like JMS or Berzerker. 
- Increased Dust per pack in the market - for the same price.

And some minor balancing changes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 6th Anniversary!
notes.content:
It's Idle Wizards' 6th Anniversary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/40a72195f539e19b8754d141cad6bcc9a62b5b2b.png[/img]

For a month, starting today, everyone logging in will receive some bonus stuff and buffs.

The update also includes some new things, such as:

- 3 new items (a unique helmet and 2 leg items)
- 3 new memory upgrades.
- New Bat Hunter skin.
- Attributes are now stronger on average, with some extremes toned down.

A big change:
You can now change your target FPS to 30, 60 or 120 in the settings screen (60 by default).
Reckless autocast of instant spells is no longer tied to the frame rate, max cast rate is now fixed at 60 times per second.

Come join us for celebration!

notes.title: 1.32 update is now up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/c7b5b908885ecb826359a18963bc138d537c2b71.png[/img]

The Dread. New ascension form, can be accessed by Heretic, Desolator and Temporalist.
Increases Gods' main ability power. Shares Voidbolt, Artificial Muse and True Sorcery spells, and grants the Manifest Twisted Reality spell - a Permanent Evocation that boosts Character Ability Power and Idle profit bonus.
Dread's unique feature is a second Pet slot. The secondary pet cannot be of the same evolution tree, and you can only utilize one T3 Pet at a time. Pet Ability Power affects the secondary Pet at a square root of normal Pet Ability Power.

New decorative feature: Bat Hunter skins! 5 for now, and we'll keep making more over time.

Base crafting dust income increased by 12%. Greater Chimaera and Simulacrum pets crafting dust bonuses were removed - no need to sit on Chimaera to stack dust anymore.

And some minor balancing changes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.31 update is now up!
notes.content:
A big QoL patch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/ca2a9028fc60b2ccb54e121129a1d78ed12bb6a5.png[/img]

New legacies, achievements and Steam achievements. Steam Paragon achievements have been redone in favor of Legacy levels.

Gate to the Past should be fixed and display the time properly now!

Almost all windows can now be closed by using their respective hotkeys, e.g. pressing N a second time will close the Interiors window.

Upgrading items now yields a constant amount of progress instead of a random one (on average, upgrading items became cheaper). No more fishing for Perfects!

Item and Spell presets now saves for each pair of Class+Ascension Form. Switch and try out those with ease!

And some balancing:

A swath of changes to Shaman and their Pets - less upfront power, more power with long and real long exiles. More upfront power on Risen Giant with less capability for time scaling.

Psychic Cacophony now starts less powerful, but grows way faster with Levels, and has a tad more Pet Ability scaling to it. 

Demonologist is now way more playable and accessible from the start, and a bit stronger overall.

And quite a bit of other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: War In Heaven
notes.content:
1.30 update, "War In Heaven", is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/3961733bd8bb6def11b9c8b4f819deb71b36871e.png[/img]

The Cosmic events have not gone unnoticed. Observed and speculated upon by denizens of new Realms, these event bring even greater opportunities to the Wizards.

New feature: Ascension forms
Ascension forms is a further evolution of Class system. Ascensions can be performed upon reaching e1100 Mysteries. Each Ascension form has a roster of 3 classes that are eligible to Ascend into it. Upon Ascending, you:
- retain all the spells and character abilities of the base class
- gain a certain (fixed) Spell from the 2 other potential Classes
- gain a new Ascension form ability
- gain a new Ascension form Spell
- gain a unique, powerful feature

Currently, there are 2 forms available: The Tempest and The Demiurge

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/2d62862c129b6952e61f506278fcdf61a4d86d12.png[/img]
The Tempest form can be accessed by Archon, Oni and Desolator.
Tempest's unique feature is a 7th Spell Scroll

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/34c1aa2ad5c47edd0c5b5ece4bd572b341124cb1.png[/img]
The Demiurge form can be accessed by Heretic, Shaman and Temporalist
Demiurge's unique feature is a 9th Mana Source - Pocket Universe

In the future, we will release at least 2 more Ascension forms, so that each T2 class will have a choice of Ascension.

Also included:
- 3 new Psychic Cacophony perks
- New memory for higher Enchant cap
- Desolator Alchemist-spells cheapening upgrades
- New save backup system - for now it's external, to allow for recovery of bad corruption cases. If it proves to be efficient we'll do our best to integrate it directly.

And some other balancing and qol

Come visit us!

notes.title: Version 1.26 published
notes.content:
1.26 update is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/9290cff98a53b4404a9ba809c43ae60390192921.png[/img]

Void Memetics are now unlocked at e650 and hugely buffed, including a new bonus accumulated through excess echoes gathered. Accordingly, Catalyst Memetics are now unlocked at e750 and Red Power has been significantly toned down.

notes.title: Version 1.25 published
notes.content:
1.25 update is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/be8d56c33f396122ce25cd6316d9324b24784837.png[/img]

A new tab of Memory upgrades called Imprints was added. Memory Upgrades from this tab are mostly aimed at easying the transfer from one Realm to another - from preserving Catalysts to granting you more Memories upon switching Realms. They utilize a separate pool of Memories, equal in amount to the Memories utilized for old Memory Upgrades.

Some upgrades were rehashed, and a grand total of 7 new memory upgrades was added.
4 new backgrounds and 7 new orb skins included!

And some other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.23 published
notes.content:
1.23 update is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/ea9eb2009d4fb15e87ece16ff74e0826ebaee790.png[/img]

New feature: Minor Gods.
Minor Gods are now available at e1000 Mysteries mark. These new Gods provide bonuses to a variety of stats and work similarly to the usual Pantheon Gods, with the exception of leveling method - instead of gaining experience on their own, they leech it off their "parent" Gods as long as they (new minor ones) are active. The leeching speed is twice the speed of experience gain by old Gods.

Renown II now grants +1 to the max amount of chosen Gods. All other same bonuses in Renown levels increased by 1, up to 3 (was 2). 

Two new Memories that increase the cata/edust-derived multipliers to Memories gained. Time multiplier from Memories formula changed.

Desolator and Heretic balance changes.

And some other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.10 published
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/9a4c57062ad8e26837b858d91cf70886f05ccc36.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow Wizards!

Patch V1.10 is live!
With a bunch of new stuff available:
- Utilize a new type of currency to augment your Void Traps. When you unlock Memetics, a new mode for your traps will become available. Those do not grant Void Mana, but instead provide bonuses, and possess experience and levels. The bonuses include Void profits, mana per entity, Traps' experience and spawn speed and increase with the Trap's level. They accumulate a new type of entities (called Echoes) over time, which, when collected, provide experience to their respective trap. You are still able to access old Void Traps by switching those inside the Memetics menu, and they still function in the background for the purposes of Radiance, Voidmancer ability etc. The Echoes accumulate slowly, and stack up to 5 (15 with a new memory upgrade), so you only need to check on them once in a long while. They also work offline. 
- We're removing Super-crits and have rebalanced basic crits to compensate the potential profit loss. The reason for this is Supercrits are pretty unstable in terms of profits, work a bit weird and hard to understand.
- The crafting dust income is now higher than it was in the pre-Realms part. The amount is tuned to it's the same as before once all upgrades are maxed.
- The Memories Upgrades are massively reworked. There is 10 new upgrades available, and overall amount of profit available is greatly increased. However, Memory Upgrades are now locked by total amount of Memories earned on individual basis, meaning a set of them is available from start, and a lot of later ones open up as you earn more and more Memories.

(This means that Memories invested are reset for everyone. Re-invest wisely.)

- We're finally adding a big set of new higher-level achievements like total buildings etc. suitable for higher Mysts levels, and a few more Legacy levels.
- 19 new skins, and skin inheriting for the Pets similar to what Character classes have.

notes.title: Version 1.05 published
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/4e7836bf7249e51deb2f68d4f7fee1021d0b3e46.png[/img]
Greetings, fellow Wizards!
Patch V1.05 is live!
- A major rework of Expeditions, with a deck-building mechanic, available spells roster expanded drastically, and new content like monsters, enemy spells, locations and a couple of new combat mechanics added.
- Pet Skins! A lot of you have been asking about this for ages, and they're finally there. We don't have too many on start (after all, characters skins have been built up to what they're now for years), but now we have the ability to add a couple here and a couple there. Abolisher and Archon pets supported, too! We're starting with a unique skin for each T3 Pet and around 10 simpler skins for various T1-T2 Pets, and will be adding more over time with small patches.
- A rework of Experiments. This has been a long time coming, we've remade the one unified Experiment into separate categories with uneven or single-type costs, and thus are attempting to make Crafting Dust colors unique in purpose (unlike now, where they're basically the same). Our goal is to also implement some more ways to spend Crafting Dust in future.
And some other minor fixes and updates.
Major note: Due to this, we're abolishing the Trade Week!
With the way the crafting will work from now on, trading with 100% efficiency won't allow us to make the dust feel unique, and will allow for abuses that we won't be able to balance out. Naturally, it'll be replaced by another, new one not related to trading Dust.
A few weeks later we'll be publishing the second part of the patch (v1.1), which will introduce a new core-game mechanic along with some more content and balancing based on feedback.

notes.title: Version 1.02 published
notes.content:
Core mechanics:
- 3 additional item presets.
- 32 new upgrades.
- Green catalysts gain cap now starts at 1000. This can be increased by a new memory upgrade.
- Completed trials value can now be increased by new memory upgrade.
- Spells' and Weapons' values that scale from mana sources now include additional sources (like the ones gained from red catalysts).

Balance:
- Some of the upgrades costs rebalanced.
- Convertion rates into memories rebalanced.
- Green catalysts drop in expedition reduced overall. Blue catalysts drop in expedition increased.
- Catalysts drop in expeditions now diminish as you earn more within a short period of time. The amount is then gradually restored over time.
- Idle expedition now continues the run up to 100% after losing a battle instead of abandoning it. No reward is given for the lost encounter, but further ones are unaffected.
- Time of idle expedition is now based on encounter difficulty and your level.
- Forge. Potential amount of slots increased to 12 (was 6), base amount of slots is 2 (was 1).
- Forge. Base speed of recovery doubled.
- "Expanded Mind" Memory upgrade. Maximum level increased to 10 (was 2), the cost was reduced and rebalanced accordingly (base cost is greatly reduced, but the overall sum is now greater).
- "Temper The Steel" spell. Passive effect reworked, the old effect is now scales from current amount of casts (changed to an active effect). New persistent effect.
- "Gem Resonance" spell. Now scales from mysteries.
- "Voidlight Amalgam" pet. Void profits bonus scaling increased.
- "Planned Progress" Memory upgrade. Now increases Idle and Offline bonus.
- Mechanos Apexis pet. Scaling from pet active time when it's over 3 days is now stronger.
- Abolisher main ability bonus increased.
- Alchemist main ability bonus increased.
- Ironsoul main ability and berserk stance bonuses increased.
- Desolator elixirs bonuses increased.
- Temporalist. Scale from time and skipped time increased.

And many bug fixes.

notes.title: "Breaking the Silence" expansion is live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/6df909366b3635ac461f4751abeabb8318e9e252.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow Wizard!

Idle Wizard have had a huge release! 

With version 1.00 aka "Breaking the Silence", we're officially out of beta!

- New Feature - Realms and Memories. 
Upon reaching a certain Paragon level you become able to Change Realm. Doing this will convert all of your mysteries, catalysts and enchanting dust into Memories, keeping only Achievements, Pet/Class unlocked status, Expedition, Crafting Dust, Runes and Special Currencies untouched. You lose immediate access to most of the features, mysteries, catalysts, enchanting dust, trial milestones. With Memories earned you are able to buy new special permanent upgrades, and start a new playthrough, capable of reaching higher mysteries. 

- New Feature - Pantheon. 
You get access to Pantheon menu, where you can select one of the Gods to worship it, earning it xp over time. Each of the Gods gives you a bonus (or bonuses), based on their current level regardless of being currently worshipped or not. With later paragons you can unlock more Gods, and unlock their second bonuses.

UI has received significant changes:
- Bottom UI buttons reworked and replaced with new ones.
- Top menu. The order of info labels was changed, info label about critical profits added.
- Scroll page reworked.
- New Help menu - contains most of the game's terms with a description of its mechanics.
- New tutorial menu - guides you through the game's first steps.

Introducing the Bat Hunter:
- "Bat Hunter". New market item. A permanent mini-pet that automatically preys upon bats, granting you the corresponding award upon catching one. Costs 40 relics.

Also:

- Two new Trial types
- Paragons split into Paragons and Legacy and significantly rebalanced. Paragons unlock features, are based on Mysteries and Memories amounts and reset with changing Realm. Legacy have special conditions and give bonuses that persist through Realm changes. 
- Trial auto-mode introduced for "Trial of Innovation" and "Trial of Patience".
- Enchantments now have a maximum level, default value is 20, and can be increased by a corresponding Memory upgrade.
- New option - disenchant all items. Cost 10 Disenchantment Cores. Available via a button loacted under Dust trading in Equipment menu.
- "Nullifier core". New resource, used for reset Expedition attributes (costs 1), Invested catalysts (costs 2), Character attributes (costs 3) and Memories (costs 5). You can buy them in market, get as reward for Trial of Patience or get as reward for promo-codes or events.
- Trial milestones reworked. Last milestones now require 1000 trials completed. Bonuses rebalanced, time reduction bonuses after winning or losing a trial is now replaced by rune generation rate bonuses. Added 5 new milestones.
- 69 new upgrades.
- 47 new achievements.

notes.title: 3rd Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/e463fc529d62f53509c5c8a26bb6fba30344432d.png[/img]

notes.title: "New Frontiers"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/8a898d48ba2cbe2b785bed94337fdc432a2f0221.png[/img]

Despite all the efforts of the Realm's wizards, the world continues to destabilize. Wilderness grows restless, its denizens - aggressive, strong and weird. Strange beings dwell beneath the cities, in deep swamps and abandoned castles. Magical and temporal anomalies further twist and pervert the creatures of the Realm, and give birth to new, even more dangerous ones.

It's time for the Wizards of all lands to set out on a journey across the lands - and fight!

[b]New Feature: Expedition.[/b]
New game sub-mode. Leave the comfort of your cozy wizard tower and venture out into the wild, encounter and defeat various creatures, earn trophies, gather catalysts, learn new spells, grow stronger and progress further.
The Expedition is a separate game mode which features card game-style battles with monsters. It has a separate power progress, and is connected to the main game mainly through the collection of red catalysts and items.
Do try it with "particle effects" turned on!

[b]New Item Slot: Trophy. [/b]
You have a chance to get new items, if you have the items feature unlocked, by killing monsters in Expedition. Each type of monster has its own item type. First time you unlock the common quality item, and gain progress at improving quality of item each time you get same trophy from monster afterwards. Chance and how much progress you get is based on monster level.

New Catalyst type: Red catalysts, which give you free mana sources. Main source of new catalysts is Expedition.

[b]Core mechanics:[/b]
- 12 new items (Trophy slot).
- 10 new achievements (connected to Expedition).
- 6 new monsters in Valor Trial.
- Catalysts now have a soft cap regarding the amount received. You can't get more than this value from a single source. To reflect these changes, your catalysts were reverted back into shards. In cases where the catalyst amount would apply the aforementioned cap, the sum will be reduced accordingly.
- Attribute resets removed from the game. All your resets converted into relics. Now each attribute reset during a run cost 1 relic.

[b]Balance:[/b]
- Paragon 4. Bonus removed, now it unlock Expedition.
- Paragon 47, 57. Bonus blue catalysts power reduced to 0.5% (was 1%)
- Paragon 38 now increase green catalysts power by 12.5%
- Paragons 39, 45, 51, 58, 64 now increases red catalysts power by 10% (additive) (1.5 efficiency total)
- Red catalyst shards included in reward lists from bats, experiments and trials.
- Bat rewards rebalanced. Increased chance for dust, enchanting dust, green catalyst shards. Reduced chance for blue catalyst shards. Bats' loot amount bonus now affects it more adequately.
- Experiment rewards rebalanced. Increased chance for enchanting dust, green catalyst shards. Reduced chance for relic, alteration sands, trial runes, blue catalyst shards.
- Trial rewards rebalanced. Increased chance for blue catalyst shards. Reduced chance for alteration sands, buffs, green catalyst shards.
- "Holidays" research item. Increased enchanting bonus per level to 35% (was 30%)

Note: Idea of rebalanced reward lists is:
 - make Experiment and Bats the main source for green catalysts, Trials - for blue catalysts, Expedition - for red catalyst.
 - increase value of enchanting dust income. 

[b]UI:[/b]
- Improved tooltips.
- Improved some labels.
- Statistic menu's Total tab now has information about collected enchanting dust.
- Trial Rune renamed into Rune.

[b]Market:[/b]
- Expedition pack. Receive an assortment of Expedition consumables: 2 Greater Healing Potions, Arcane Bombs and Bottled Lightnings, 3 of every Glyph, Draught and Limited Invulnerability Rings, 5 Lesser Healing Potions and Sealed Scrolls.
- Attribute reset pack removed.

[b]Technical issues:[/b]
- New tooltip system.
- Reworked sound effect system.
- Fixed game crash when collecting a Void Entity.
- Fixed issue with Runes received while offline.
- Void Entity/Shadow Clot now give fixed (not a random) value of Void Mana/Liquid Shadows.
- Fixed issue with wrong amount of Time Warps and Get Mysteries received from Server reward system.
- Frame per second limited to 120 for the browser version.
- Fixed a bug regarding activating locked attribute perks.

notes.title: "Grave Omens"
notes.content:
New Feature: Tier 3 Pets
Some of the T2 Pets can now be evolved into T3 ones, much more powerful, combining powers from various ones and usually focused on longer runs. Accessible starting from Paragon 55.

For now, 6 are available (1 is only available to Archon), and we'll be introducing more!

New Trial mode: Trial of Research
All of the Realm's magic-users are busy performing research on every aspect of magic - participate too! Trial of Research is a new kind of idle trial - spend a Trial Rune to start a research, which takes an hour to finish and rewards new items of a new type, usual rewards - and from now on you can perform various types of Trials in parallel!

New Feature: Versatility attribute.
A special attribute without a cap that allows you to distribute any excess attribute points to get extra power. Accessible starting from Paragon 10.

Core mechanics:
- New item slot: Research items. These items can be created and upgraded through Research trials.
- 5 new paragon levels.
- 26 new achievements.
- 3 new secret achievements.
- 157 new upgrades (9 connected to achievements).
- 10 new items (research items)
- All trials work in parallel now.
- Each trial has a different reward value now.

Balance:
- Reality Prism weapon. Changed bonus mechanic to a more convenient one.
- Shaman. Abilities growth rate reduced.
- Desolator. Ability bonuses reduced.
- Zombie, Risen Giant. Profits ability now scales strongly with pet time.
- Geode pet. Attribute bonus reduced.
- Ley Keeper pet. Attribute bonus increased.
- "Void Fission" spell. Scale from current Liquid Shadows reduced.
- Oni. Abilities power reduced.
- Some upgrades (connected to specific class mana source) cost and bonus rebalanced.

UI:
- Trial menu reworked.
- Clicking on an item slot changes the filter to the respective item type.

Technical issues:
- Fixed an issue with the Wizard Squad challenges.
- Minor bugfixes.

notes.title: "Age of Strife"
notes.content:
New feature: Mana source catalysts
Catalysts are small, stackable source of power which augment your Mana Sources. There are two types of catalysts, a lesser one, granting you cumulative bonus for each obtained, and a greater one, granting you multiplicative bonus for each one. Both are applied at the same time, and are carried over exiles.
You can obtain them from multiple sources, but the most reliable one is completing Trials of Valor.

New Trial mode: Trial of Valor
As various threats emerge throughout the world, you can use your Crystal Ball for divining and engaging them from the safety of your tower. You fight using three types of attacks, and each threat is constantly changing it's resistances to various types - make sure to try and use the one it's not protected from at the moment. Each attack type has limited charges which can be replenished instantaneously by spending a Trial Rune.

The most prominent reward for completing Trials of Valor are Mana source catalysts.

Core mechanics:
- New item slot: Offhand items. These items usually grow in power as you utilize some of the game mechanics, like giving a bonus depending on amount of Spells cast, Pet levels earned, etc.
- Additional reward for completing trials.
- 10 new items
- 16 new trial milestones
- 14 new paragon levels
- 34 new achievements
- 66 new upgrades
- Secret achievements now display names while not yet unlocked

Balance:
- Paragon 37 reward changed (now unlock offhand slot)
- "Time Shaper" upgrade, requirement changed (now e475 mysteries, was e500)
- Trial milestones are mixed

UI:
- New item filter. You can search for an item by entering words, found in the name, description or enchanting description of an item.
- Improved some menus.
- Improved main UI.
- Tooltips for Trial reward.

Technical issues:
- Fixed issue with tooltip of "Summon Winged Night" spell when you have 0 void mana.
- Fixed issue with critical counter in "Rule of Nature" challenges.
- Game resources optimization.
